name: Explorer's Method
description: The habit of estimating, measuring and recording carefully before drawing a conclusion — established in Mission 3 (Explorer's Toolkit) and used in every mission afterward.

name: Expedition's Wider Objectives
description: The realisation, from Mission 12's observatory (Star Maps), that the original expedition's research reached beyond Outpost Echo itself.

name: Pattern Recognition
description: Recognising that a trend seen in one dataset only becomes meaningful once matched against another — established in Mission 13 (Hidden Patterns).

name: Environmental Context
description: Reading a landscape itself as evidence — connecting rock layers, samples and maps to explain past decisions, established in Mission 16 (Secrets Underground).
